_: THE LANGUAGES OF THE COLLEGE.
Ten editions are planned. Two are published. This file is the only
place that distinction lives, so the language picker, the <link
rel=alternate> tags and any test that counts editions all read the
same list and cannot disagree.
TO PUBLISH AN EDITION: set `published` to true and give it a `prefix`.
The picker links it, the alternate tags announce it, and
tests/languages.test.mjs then REQUIRES the pages to exist — an edition
cannot be marked published before it can be served.
ORDER IS DELIBERATE. Arabic sits first among the working editions
after English, ahead of every other language, because more than 7,000
of the College's learners are in the Gulf and more than 3,000 in Saudi
Arabia alone. It is a principal working language of the College, not a
translation of it.
THE UNPUBLISHED EDITIONS ARE NOT RENDERED, and there is no label for
them any more. The picker used to list all ten, the eight unpublished
ones marked "In preparation" — in the chrome of every page, in both
editions. WEC Press had already settled the principle for its own
catalogue: "nothing planned, in preparation or forthcoming appears
here — a catalogue that lists intentions is a prospectus wearing a
catalogue's clothes". The same is true of a language menu, and the
picker had simply never been held to it.
The plan stays here because this is where the College knows what it
intends. It is not published because an intention is not an edition.
